reverseBrief.humanQuestion: How do I join this room with my LAiDIES account and return safely?
reverseBrief.promisedPayoff: Sign in once, choose a public display name if needed, and return to the selected conversation.
reverseBrief.priorKnowledge: The visitor is on a community room and may have a Resident account.
reverseBrief.centralMentalModel: LAiDIES authenticates the Resident account; Hyvor hosts public comments and moderation.
reverseBrief.dailyLifeConnection: A person can sign in, name themselves for a public room, and know whether the conversation actually opened.
reverseBrief.surfaceJob: Make the existing one-account community handoff understandable, truthful and recoverable.
reverseBrief.desiredFeeling: I know what I am signing into, where I will return, and what did or did not happen.
reverseBrief.desiredReaderFeeling: I know what I am signing into, where I will return, and what did or did not happen.

plainClarity.observation: The display-name label explains exactly who sees the name. Sign-in, saving and retry controls use ordinary verbs. Earlier frame/receipt jargon is absent.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: The name people will see beside your comments

readerValue.observation: The account page promises return to the selected conversation, directly addressing the interruption that signing in creates. The separate runtime test must prove this promise.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: Check your email for the LAiDIES sign-in link. It will bring you back to the conversation.

laidiesVoice.observation: Town language in the house remains light and recognizable; account controls speak directly to the visitor. No invented character voice or technical authentication vocabulary is introduced.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: Every wing and room is open to explore.

engagingEnjoyable.observation: Short checking/opening states let the room prompt remain the focus. The interaction invites participation without making account setup a lesson. This is appropriate restraint for sign-in, not a claim that authentication itself is entertaining.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: Opening the conversation with your LAiDIES account…

factualIntegrity.observation: The text distinguishes an account from a device Card and names the public nature of comments. Success wording is reserved for provider confirmation in the candidate logic; prose admission alone does not prove that confirmation works.

freshnessReviewability.observation: The inventory binds each message to a file and state, and explicitly identifies current revisions. Provider responsibilities are stable role statements but must be rechecked if hosting or authentication changes.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: The listed community-room state and shared-boundary strings were revised in this integration’s prose-admission repair

surfaceFit.observation: Display-name choice, pending status, retry and sign-out failures correspond to distinct interaction states. Messages remain short enough for the room panel and account page.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: Your display name could not be saved. Please try again.

dailyLifeConnection.observation: The public-name prompt makes a real social consequence understandable: this is the name other participants will see beside comments.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: The name people will see beside your comments

communicationBenchmark.observation: The account/Card distinction explains the invisible mechanism only as far as a visitor needs: a saved Card does not sign someone in. The UI then provides the account action.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: a Card saved only in this browser does not sign you in.

usefulAction.observation: Sign in and Save my display name identify concrete controls. The email instruction says where to continue and what the link returns to; no vague invitation to explore replaces the action.

practiceFeedback.observation: The inventory distinguishes success from provider rejection and failed logout. In particular, failed logout is not described as completed. These are useful observable outcomes for an interaction rather than a teaching exercise.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: Sign-out did not complete. Please try again.

honestLimits.observation: The persistent public-room notice names confidential material to keep out and points to reporting. The Burn Book text explicitly withholds promises of publication or rewards. Runtime acceptance remains outside this review.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: A comment does not guarantee LAiDIES review, moderation, publication, a new Mall shop, or a reward.
